$ rea inspect-byte-entropy --schema
exit: 0
--- stdout
args:
  type: object
  properties:
    path:
      type: string
      minLength: 1
      pattern: "^[^\\x00]*$"
      description: Local file
  required[1]: path
  additionalProperties: false
options:
  type: object
  properties:
    blockSize:
      default: 4096
      anyOf[2]:
        - type: integer
          minimum: 256
          maximum: 65536
        - type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]+$"
      description: Power-of-two block size from 256 to 65536 bytes
    offset:
      default: 0
      anyOf[2]:
        - type: integer
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 9007199254740991
        - type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]+$"
      description: Window start as a decimal file byte offset
    length:
      anyOf[2]:
        - type: integer
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 9007199254740991
        - type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]+$"
      description: Window length in bytes; omit to extend through EOF
  additionalProperties: false
globals:
  type: object
  properties:
    timings:
      default: false
      description: Write measured command timing to stderr.
      type: boolean
  required[1]: timings
  additionalProperties: false
<end>
--- stderr
<end>
